title: Audit Inputs
task: Review AGENTS.md conventions, existing CLI/orchestrator crates, and the Claude Code sub-agent spec to capture compatibility requirements and current gaps.

title: Design Architecture
task: Draft a pluggable architecture (crate boundaries, traits, data flow) that maps Codex agent lifecycle to Claude register/handshake APIs, including diagrams or tables for reviewers.

title: Scaffold Subagent Crate
task: Introduce a new codex-subagent crate with feature-gated interfaces, shared models for Claude subagents, and minimal unit tests validating serialization.

title: Implement Registration Flow
task: Add concrete orchestrator glue so Codex can register Claude-compatible subagents (config parsing, manifest validation, handshake helpers) with thorough error handling.

title: Wire Orchestration
task: Integrate the subagent orchestrator into existing runtime entrypoints (CLI/server) so subagents can be discovered, initialized, and invoked deterministically.

title: Document Usage
task: Create docs describing how to implement, register, and orchestrate subagents (flow diagrams, config examples, lifecycle reference) plus a runnable demo manifest.

title: Add Validation & Tests
task: Author targeted unit/integration tests (including mocked Claude API interactions) proving registration/orchestration flows succeed and reject invalid manifests.

title: Quality Gates
task: Run just fmt, just fix -p <affected>, and scoped cargo test suites; document the commands and their outcomes for reviewers.
